method: Xtensa objdump on exact mapped ELF; selected branch targets decoded afresh; original bytes verified

findings.observation: u16 count returned via stack offset56 is compared with119. Count<=119 sets object bytes+0xce2 and+0xce3 to1, and logs need rebuild,map_count. Count>119 enters further tests. This is a map-data validity condition, not a lap count.

After startup flags, yaw deltas from current pose are processed by0x40378adc and accumulated in float object+0xd3c. Absolute accumulated yaw is compared with exact4*pi. The corresponding logged branch sets byte+0xd44=1 and calls state-transition routine0x4201c174 with12=FWBMS_END. A second2*pi branch requires0x4201b778 return0 and geometric helper0x40378bcc result<0.5, then takes the same END transition.
Transition routine logs old/new state names through table0x3fc9bd94, saves old state object+0xb3c to+0xb40, and stores new state at+0xb3c. Table proves12 is END.

Map-completion branch reads signed accumulated-yaw-like field+0xbe4. Values<-3141 log Error side to build the map. Otherwise success continuation requires value>6020 AND u16 map size atobject+20>59. Failing first requirement logs Didnt go around; passing yaw but size<60 logs Finish Building Map Too Soon. These failure cases set error flags and invoke a common callback.

Secondary2*pi exit requires a helper false. Helper fetches message14 into stack and returns1 exactly when signed16 fields+8,+10 are both>100 and at least one>150. Field meanings and units are not established.

limitations: The4*pi condition exits a startup state; it is not evidence that every mowing job commands exactly two border circuits.
Map completion thresholds6020/-3141 suggest scaled radians but units require tracing producer; no degree or meter interpretation asserted.
Geometric helper computes squared XY differences then calls0x4210c100; square-root semantics not independently verified here.
ROM comparison/helper names are inferred from surrounding numeric conversions and log branches, not recovered symbols.
